verdict.rationale: Column is a developer banking API that handles customer financial data, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for it. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or training-exclusion control. Items like custom roles, API key modes, and sandbox isolation are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
